title: maxSnippetBytes minimum value not specified
description: The account capability maxSnippetBytes has no minimum value. A server advertising maxSnippetBytes: 0 is technically conformant but useless. A practical floor (e.g. 128 bytes) should be specified, or the spec should state what clients should do when the advertised maximum is too small to render a useful notification.
close_reason: Decision: no floor. maxSnippetBytes: 0 is valid. If a server advertises zero, clients get no snippets. Maximally permissive; no precedent in emailpush for a floor.
